title: Browser back from an invoice restores filters; sort and columns; rows shut
refs: SV-8607 (SBC spec v20 2026-08-17 Story 9 S9-R3; S9-R4)
preconds:
1. You are on the report with non-default filters set (for example Last Month + Service only), a non-default sort, and one column hidden.
2. You have expanded down to an invoice detail row..
steps:
1. Watch the browser address bar, then click an invoice number link.
2. From the invoice page, press the browser back button.
3. Check the report's filters, sort, visible columns, and row expansion.
expected:
1. Before navigating, the active date range and Product Type are written to the page link.
2. Pressing back returns to the report with its filters, sort, and columns restored exactly as set.
3. Expanded rows are shown collapsed again — expansion is not restored (this is the specified behavior, not a defect).

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8582, read on 17 August 2026, and the Sales By Customer report specification version 20 (S9-R3, S9-R4), read on 17 August 2026.
Last checked against build v3.8-da72171 on 8/19/2026.

AUTOMATION: HOLD - waiting on the product owner to decide whether the invoice number is a clickable link (it currently shows as plain non-clickable text and the specification is contradictory); this test depends on that decision
